arxiv-2101-08168.description: Abstract We show that Nesterov acceleration is an optimal-order iterative regularization method for linear ill-posed problems provided that a parameter is chosen accordingly to the smoothness of the solution. This result is proven both for an a priori stopping rule and for the discrepancy principle.

arxiv-2401-15303.title: Feedback-based Quantum Algorithm Inspired by Counterdiabatic Driving
arxiv-2401-15303.creator: Rajesh K. Malla, Hiroki Sukeno, Hongye Yu, Tzu-Chieh Wei, Andreas Weichselbaum, Robert M. Konik
arxiv-2401-15303.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Rajesh K. Malla, Hiroki Sukeno, Hongye Yu, Tzu-Chieh Wei, Andreas Weichselbaum, Robert M. Konik. In recent quantum algorithmic developments, a feedback-based approach has shown promise for preparing quantum many-body system ground states and solving combinatorial optimization problems. This method utilizes quantum Lyapunov control to iteratively construct quantum circuits. Here, we propose a substantial enhancement by implementing a protocol that uses ideas from quantum Lyapunov control and the counterdiabatic driving protocol, a key concept from quantum adiabaticity.

arxiv-2411-00157.title: Optimal kinematics for energy harvesting using favorable wake-foil interactions in tandem oscillating hydrofoils
arxiv-2411-00157.creator: Eric E. Handy-Cardenas, Yuanhang Zhu, Kenneth S. Breuer
arxiv-2411-00157.description: Abstract The energy harvesting performance of a pair of oscillating hydrofoil turbines in tandem configuration is experimentally studied to determine the optimal kinematics of the array. By characterizing interactions between the wake produced by the leading foil and the trailing foil, the kinematic configuration required to maximize array power extraction is determined.

pmc-11458890.creator: Kriti Tyagi, Ravindra K. Chandan, Debashis Sahoo, Srayan Ghosh, Santosh Kumar Gupta, Gopaljee Jha
pmc-11458890.description: The myo‐inositol‐1‐phosphate synthase (MIPS) catalyses the biosynthesis of myo‐inositol, an important sugar that regulates various physiological and biochemical processes in plants. Here, we provide evidence that host (SlMIPS1) and pathogen (Rs_MIPS) myo‐inositol‐1‐phosphate synthase (MIPS) genes are required for successful infection of Rhizoctonia solani, a devastating necrotrophic fungal pathogen, in tomato.

pmc-12501452.title: Migraine with brainstem aura with abnormal EEG discharges easily misdiagnosed as epilepsy: a case series study
pmc-12501452.creator: Xianyun Liu, Jing Ran, Yu Tong, Wenqi Yang, Xi Peng
pmc-12501452.description: Migraine with brainstem aura (MBA) constitutes a rare subtype of migraine, characterized by aura symptoms including vertigo, dysarthria, diplopia, tinnitus, ataxia, and impaired consciousness. Patients with MBA have been reported to exhibit abnormal electroencephalograms (EEGs) featuring diffuse slow-wave activity and bilateral slowing of the posterior head activity.

pmc-12565937.title: High-Strength Low-Alloy Steels for Automobiles: Microstructure and Mechanical Properties
pmc-12565937.creator: Guoqiang Ma, Bo Gao, Zhen Chen, Yuquan Li, Ruirui Wu, Hailian Gui, Zhibing Chu
pmc-12565937.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). High-strength low-alloy (HSLA) steel is widely used in automotive industry for reduction of consumption and emissions. The microstructure and mechanical properties of two automotive HSLA steels with different strength grades were systematically investigated in present study. Microstructural characterization was conducted using optical microscopy (OM), scanning electron microscopy (SEM), and electron backscatter diffraction (EBSD), while mechanical properties were evaluated with Vickers hardness tester and tensile tests. Both steels exhibited a ferrite matrix with spheroidized carbides/pearlites.

pmc-13183958.creator: Sara Franceschi, Mariangela Morelli, Francesca Lessi, Francesca Di Lorenzo, Paolo Aretini, Aldo Pastore, Andrea Marranci, Carlo Gambacciani, Francesco Pieri, Federico Villanacci, Nicola Montemurro, Manuel Giacomarra, Michele Menicagli, Gianmarco Ferri, Francesco Pasqualetti, Marco Krengli, Marc Sans
pmc-13183958.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Glioblastoma (GBM) is an incurable tumor where temozolomide (TMZ) resistance limits survival, even in MGMT-methylated patients. To improve stratification, we used NAD(P)H-FLIM to profile TMZ response in 35 patient-derived explants, integrating these data with transcriptomic and functional analyses. We identified BIRC3 and CAV1 upregulation in resistant tumors and investigated their parallel yet functionally cooperative role in driving an aggressive, therapy-resistant phenotype.

pmc-13242945.creator: Andrew Carroll, Dawn Brown, Domenick Silvio, James Maszatics, David A Hanauer

pmc-13262657.title: Variation in presenteeism by generosity of statutory sick pay: a multilevel analysis in 35 European countries
pmc-13262657.creator: Marvin Reuter, Tabea Gau, Sophie-Charlotte Meyer, Sascha A Ruhle
pmc-13262657.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Attending work despite illness (sickness presenteeism) is common in many workplaces. While most research has focused on individual and workplace determinants, less is known about country-level factors. This study examines (i) the association between national sick pay policies and presenteeism, (ii) the extent to which these policies contribute to cross-country variation in presenteeism, and (iii) whether associations differ by sociodemographic and occupational characteristics.

pmc-13700500.title: Perinatal outcomes of growth -restricted fetus with abnormal umbilical artery doppler waveform; a global systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-13700500.creator: Anteneh Gashaw, Mulat Ayele, Yonas Abebe, Muluken Demeke, Belete Destaw, Addisu Getnet, Yayeh Adamu
pmc-13700500.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). IntroductionIntrauterine growth restriction (IUGR) is associated with increased perinatal risks, including stillbirth, NICU admission, and neonatal complications. Doppler ultrasound helps diagnose abnormal fetal circulation in high-risk pregnancies, distinguishing IUGR from simple small-for-gestational-age fetuses. This systematic review and meta-analysis aim to assess the perinatal outcomes of IUGR with abnormal umbilical artery Doppler findings, providing valuable insights for improving risk management and healthcare practices.MethodA systematic review and meta-analysis were conducted in adherence to the PRISMA guidelines.
